VUC LANG / FIRST-PERSON DIVER ARMS

Anatomical hands, forearms and source weights are adapted from the repository's
CC0 athlete asset, derived from MakeHuman / MPFB2 hm08 through NAVER anny data
and the three.ws CC0 mirror. Original CC0 notices remain in ../CC0-LICENSE.txt,
../anny-LICENSE.md and ../anny-README.md.

Original CC0 authors credited by the mirror: Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius,
Jonas Hauquier / MakeHuman.
Source: https://github.com/nirholas/three.ws/tree/main/avatar-sources/anny
Upstream: https://github.com/naver/anny

First-person framing, glove/sleeve tailoring, wrist piping, vertex pigment,
512px roughness texture, the dedicated 37-bone rig and all four animation clips
were authored in Blender for this game. No external motion-capture animation,
SMPL-X topology, source skin image or anny Python library ships in the playable
arms derivative. The original source GLB remains separately licensed for the
preserved surfing game and for reproducible asset editing.

Game artifact: diver-arms.glb; units metres, X right / Y up / -Z forward.
Identity camera attachment. One material primitive, 16,794 triangles,
37 joints, 981,224 bytes. Clips: idle 4s, swim 3s, sprint 1.6s, scan 3s.
Authored validation and actual Blender reimport/framing renders are distinct
from the game's real-browser QA. The editable .blend, rebuild scripts, source
references and model previews are provided in the separate Blender package.
